# TildaZ v0.10.3

**Stays responsive under heavy output, copies from tmux even over SSH, and a mouse selection no longer overwrites your clipboard.**

- While a program prints a lot, what you type shows up much sooner — often around 100 ms sooner for CJK or emoji — and each tab or pane no longer keeps a CPU core busy. ([#728](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/728) · [#639](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/639))
- Selecting text no longer replaces the clipboard. Right-click copies the selection, or pastes when nothing is selected. On Linux a selection goes to the primary selection, and middle-click pastes it. ([#656](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/656) · [#657](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/657))
- Programs can copy to the clipboard with OSC 52, so copying in tmux, even over SSH, lands in your clipboard. ([#266](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/266))
- macOS: thinner, sharper text by default, and keys show up one frame sooner while a program prints a lot. ([#527](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/527) · [#732](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/732))
- Fixed a crash when a narrower window or pane cut a wide character such as Korean in a full-screen app. ([#723](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/723))

## Upgrade notes

- Selecting text with the mouse no longer replaces the clipboard. Copy with `Ctrl+Shift+C` (`Cmd+C` on macOS) or a right-click, or set `copy_on_select = true` in `[input]` to get the old behavior back. ([#656](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/656))
- macOS: `⌘Q` now follows the `quit` entry in `[keys]`. If you changed or emptied it, `⌘Q` no longer quits. ([#713](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/713))
- macOS: text is drawn with thinner strokes by default, as in iTerm2 and Ghostty. For the old, heavier look, set `macos_smoothing = true` under `[font]`. ([#527](https://github.com/ensky0/tildaz/issues/527))

## Downloads

| Platform | File | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Linux portable (glibc 2.28+) | `tildaz-v0.10.3-linux-{x86_64,aarch64}.tar.gz` | Extract and run `./install.sh --release`; no `sudo`. |
| Linux Debian / Ubuntu | `tildaz_0.10.3-1_{amd64,arm64}.deb` | Install with `dpkg` or a graphical software installer. |
| Linux Fedora / RHEL / openSUSE | `tildaz-0.10.3-1.{x86_64,aarch64}.rpm` | Install with `dnf` or the distro package tool. |
| Linux distro-independent | `TildaZ-0.10.3-{x86_64,aarch64}.AppImage` | Make executable and run; FUSE is optional. |
| Arch / Manjaro / EndeavourOS | `tildaz-0.10.3-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst` | x86_64 package. |
| macOS 14+ universal | `tildaz-v0.10.3-macos.dmg` | Apple Silicon and Intel; stable self-signed identity, not notarized. |
| Windows 10/11 x64 | `tildaz-v0.10.3-win-x64.zip` | Unzip and keep `_internal\` next to `tildaz.exe`. |
| Windows 11 ARM64 | `tildaz-v0.10.3-win-arm64.zip` | ARM64-native binary; same layout as the x64 zip. |
